account: Early on 23 December 2025 an intruder entered a rented room at 62 Street 51, Tân Hưng ward, Ho Chi Minh City. He took two laptops and the wallet, identity papers and bank card of the tenant, H.A.T., 33. A withdrawal of 14 million VND was made from the tenant's bank account. The tenant reported the burglary that morning. Tân Hưng Ward Police and the Criminal Police Division used the street AI camera system. It analyzed the masked man's gait, build, clothing, movement and facial data, identified him and reconstructed his route. At 11 p.m. on 24 December officers found Phạm Ngọc Huy, 23, of Ninh Bình, at an internet café on Tô Ký street. He had a previous conviction for theft. He confessed. VietNamNet reports that police held the suspect for investigation of theft on 25 December 2025. Dân trí reports that he told investigators that he had sold the stolen property. No source reports that the property was recovered.

ai_role.statement: The system's contribution was identification. It matched the masked intruder's gait, body shape, clothing, movement and facial data and reconstructed his route. That pointed police to him. The detention, confession and case-building were police work. The system and its vendor are not named. No official is quoted by name. Every report draws on the police account. The OECD Monitor tags the entry under privacy and data governance and respect of human rights, the concerns that come with public facial recognition.

revisions.change: Record drafted from the OECD Monitor entry and five Vietnamese reports of 25 December 2025. Filed as benefit created or restored, because a post-hoc investigation resolved a burglary and no harm was prevented. The detention time differs between outlets: Tuổi Trẻ gives 23h on 24–12, Công an nhân dân the night of 24 to 25 December, VnExpress and VietNamNet date the arrest 25 December, and Thanh Niên prints “23 giờ ngày 25.12”, which postdates its own 11:52 publication and is treated as a misprint; the date observed is 24 December. The Monitor's Pháp Luật TP.HCM link resolved only to a headline stub and is not cited; the Công an nhân dân link redirected from cand.com.vn to cand.vn when read. The victim's year of birth is 1992 (VietNamNet, CAND); the suspect's is 2002. Property recovery is not mentioned in any source; the suspect is reported to have sold the items.
Benefit type set to Reduced Violence under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Organizational Efficiency among the six first used.
Country of the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.

fields.account: Early on 23 December 2025 an intruder entered a rented room at 62 Street 51, Tân Hưng ward, Ho Chi Minh City. He took two laptops and the wallet, identity papers and bank card of the tenant, H.A.T., 33. A withdrawal of 14 million VND was made from the tenant's bank account. The tenant reported the burglary that morning. Tân Hưng Ward Police and the Criminal Police Division used the street AI camera system. It analyzed the masked man's gait, build, clothing, movement and facial data, identified him and reconstructed his route. At 11 p.m. on 24 December officers found Phạm Ngọc Huy, 23, of Ninh Bình, at an internet café on Tô Ký street. He had a previous conviction for theft. He confessed. VietNamNet reports that police held the suspect for investigation of theft on 25 December 2025. Dân trí reports that he told investigators that he had sold the stolen property. No source reports that the property was recovered.
fields.summary: The Ho Chi Minh City police's unnamed street AI camera system identified a masked burglar who took two laptops and 14 million VND on 23 December 2025; police detained him on 24 December.

revisions.change: Record drafted from the OECD Monitor entry and five Vietnamese reports of 25 December 2025. Filed as benefit created or restored, because a post-hoc investigation resolved a burglary and no harm was prevented. The detention time differs between outlets: Tuổi Trẻ gives 23h on 24–12, Công an nhân dân the night of 24 to 25 December, VnExpress and VietNamNet date the arrest 25 December, and Thanh Niên prints “23 giờ ngày 25.12”, which postdates its own 11:52 publication and is treated as a misprint; the date observed is 24 December. The Monitor's Pháp Luật TP.HCM link resolved only to a headline stub and is not cited; the Công an nhân dân link redirected from cand.com.vn to cand.vn when read. The victim's year of birth is 1992 (VietNamNet, CAND); the suspect's is 2002. Property recovery is not mentioned in any source; the suspect is reported to have sold the items.
Benefit type set to Reduced Violence under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Organizational Efficiency among the six first used.
Country of the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.
